subject: Urgent: EdgeWorks production degradation — request for executive review & commercial remedy
messages:
From: Soren Bjornsen <soren@edgeworks.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: EdgeWorks Procurement <procurement@edgeworks.io>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Production latency spike and errors impacting inference — urgent

Lauren —

We started seeing a severe degradation in production this morning (around 08:45 PDT) affecting our inference traffic for the EU and US regions. Key symptoms: 
- 95th pct latency jumped from ~300ms to ~1.6s for model rwd-llama-v3 on the default route
- 5xx error rate spiked to ~6% for the last 30 minutes (previous baseline ~0.2%)
- Sustained throughput drop of ~40% despite steady incoming request volume

This is directly impacting customer SLAs and we are receiving escalations from three strategic accounts. We've attached a short sampling of request traces and error logs (incident-samples.log). Please escalate to your operations and commercial leadership — we need an exec-level triage call and a proposal for commercial remediation (credits/refund) no later than today.

We open a renewal discussion in Q3 and this incident is material to that conversation. If we can’t get a clear mitigation and a commercial restitution path now, we will have to escalate this internally on our end.

Thanks,
Soren Bjornsen
Head of Platform, EdgeWorks
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: incident-samples.log (text)

Lauren

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Soren Bjornsen <soren@edgeworks.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T12:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production latency spike and errors impacting inference — urgent

On Thu, Mar 15, 2028 at 9:14 AM Soren Bjornsen <soren@edgeworks.io> wrote:
> Lauren —
>
> We started seeing a severe degradation in production this morning ...

Soren — quick update from infra: we reproduced the 95th pct jump in our staging harness when routing through the rwd-llama-v3-gpu cluster where a recent kernel swap was activated. Initial findings: a mis-selection of quantized kernel paths for longer sequences caused CPU context stalls inside the runtime; that combined with an aggressive batching window increased tail latency and triggered backpressure that manifested as 5xxs.

Mitigations we’ve enacted (in order):
1) Rolling revert of the kernel selection tweak on the affected pool (complete 12:10 PDT)
2) Forced scale-up of two burst nodes in the US pool and rebalanced traffic (12:22 PDT)
3) Temporarily tightened per-request batch windows to reduce tail amplification

Early telemetry shows error rate down to ~0.8% and 95th latencies falling toward ~520ms. We need a full RCA and a patch to the kernel selection heuristic (ETA 48 hours) and a runbook update to prevent auto-application of the heuristic without a canary run.

Commercially: we propose a provisional commercial makeup framework while we complete RCA: a one-time credit equivalent to 25% of March subscription charges for EdgeWorks, to be finalized after the RCA and signed addendum. Finance/legal reviewing (cc Marcus). I’ve attached the preliminary SLO analysis table (slo_analysis_q3.csv) and a draft runbook update (runbook_patch.md).

Dev Patel
Principal Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: slo_analysis_q3.csv (csv), runbook_patch.md (text)
From: Soren Bjornsen <soren@edgeworks.io>

Lauren —

Appreciate the quick mitigation steps and the transparency. The improvements are visible, but this incident materially impacted two paying customers and will affect our renewal discussion.

Commercial ask from EdgeWorks: we need a firm remediation proposal, not a provisional figure. Given the customer impact and the expected contractual remediations in our agreement, EdgeWorks expects a commercial restitution at minimum equal to three months of the current committed monthly subscription for affected workloads (deal EW-2027-09). We’re prepared to sign an amendment to document the credit once legal confirms the language.

Can Redwood commit to providing a draft amendment and an exec-level call (VP+ from commercial) today at 14:00 PDT? We’ll have our Head of Procurement and our COO on the line.

Soren

Thank you — we can commit to the 14:00 PDT exec call and I’ve invited our VP of Commercial (Jonas) and Head of Finance (Marcus). We’ll provide a concrete amendment draft for the proposed commercial restitution ahead of the call.

High-level offer we will put on the table in writing before the meeting:
- Provisional credit equivalent to three months of committed run-rate for the impacted workloads, subject to final RCA adjustments and a signed amendment.
- Priority engineering support and a 90-day elevated SLA monitoring window at no extra charge.
- Formal runbook and kernel-selection heuristic updates with a documented canary gating process.

DocuSign preview and HubSpot deal reference are linked here: https://docusign.com/RED-EdgeWorks-ESCL-2028 and https://hubspot.company/deal/EW-2027-09. Marcus will follow up with exact invoicing/credit mechanics.

We’ll cover the technical patch timeline on the call and confirm sign-off steps for the amendment.

Looking forward to resolving this quickly for EdgeWorks.

Lauren Bishop
